[1/3] Plan: visual polish for celestial naming, combat hud typography, solar corona prominence and radar thruster trails

impact_assessment.why: Raw snake_case underscores in planet names, combat distance text colliding with enemy ship name, and flat star/ship motion reduce immersion and visual appeal in the cockpit.
impact_assessment.benefits: Clean typography in HUD and radar, zero text collisions in combat modal, dynamic solar corona flare visuals, and responsive thruster plume particles during ship travel.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no REST API or save format change; dependency: static JS and galaxy generator; concurrency: none; state: backward-compatible body names; regression: test suite must maintain 100% pass.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Automated test suite (94 test suites) + tools/ui_audit.py + tools/ui_browser.py headless Edge screenshot review.
